text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho has garnered a great deal of attention as a showdown between two top contenders—Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reminded of the spring Tenno Sho they ran together, Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio find themselves very curious in the outcome.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond is delighted to be contributing to the Umamusume world through the attention their showdown is drawing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Becoming an illustrious runner takes skill. Satono Diamond announces her intent to win the spring Tenno Sho and show everyone what she's made of!
